title: How should a change start? Ask what is still undecided
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Design chosen, many mechanical edits, good tests
Need to map code without flooding context
rule: Plan mode is for large changes with several valid designs. Tests protect a chosen design; they don't choose it.

title: Plan mode, Explore, or both?
head: Situation
Right approach
Why
rows: Plan mode plus an Explore subagent
rule: Plan mode for open design questions; Explore subagent for noisy discovery. When a task has both, use both.

title: Plan first or just do it?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Direct execution, then review the diff
Large or multi-file change, several valid approaches
Need to survey a lot of code
Behaviour hard to describe in words
Concrete input/output examples or tests first
rule: Plan for large or open changes; do small, agreed ones directly and review the diff.

title: How should a change start? Ask what is still unknown
head: Situation
Right start
Why
rows: Many files, several valid designs, requirement settled
Need to understand code without flooding context, no decision yet
Requirements unclear or held by the engineer
rule: Many files plus more than one valid design means plan mode. An Explore subagent understands; it does not decide.

title: Plan mode or direct? Ask what is still undecided
head: Situation
Right mode
Why
rows: Change fully specified, one place, test exists
Approach still open or many files affected
Need to understand unfamiliar code first
Small edit in a big file
Edit on a unique match, not a full rewrite
rule: Choose the mode by how settled and how wide the change is, not by how sensitive the area is.

title: Plan mode or direct? Ask what is still undecided
head: Situation
Approach
Why
rows: Many files and an open design choice
rule: Multi-file change with an open design choice → plan mode before any edits.

title: Plan mode or direct execution?
head: Situation
Mode
Why
rows: Many files, several valid approaches, unknown dependencies
Small, well-scoped change with a clear fix
rule: Large change with open choices: plan mode first. Small clear change: go direct.
